english.title: Remain on land after order to leave - Badgers Act
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been found committing an offence under section 1 of the Protection of Badgers Act 1992 and being lawfully required to quit the land, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), wilfully remained on the land
